user.title: Select a source
user.description:
Choose a weather station or road camera. Additional sources can be added to the same integration.

On first installation: close this dialog, reload the Home Assistant page, then reopen setup before choosing a source.

weather_station.title: Select a weather station
weather_station.description:
Choose a county, then a municipality, then a source. The lists update immediately. Submit once when all three are selected. Administrative geography: [© Kartverket]({kartverket_url}). Road data: Statens vegvesen.

If the dropdowns are missing, close setup, reload the page, and reopen setup.
